decision: No code changes; reviewed existing evaluator and Tkinter UI.
generated: Identified reusable evaluate(), format_result(), SafeEvaluator, and existing CalculatorApp. Validation gaps: blank/whitespace input is silently ignored, malformed expressions are reported generically, non-finite numeric results are not rejected, and UI entry handling allows arbitrary text that is only validated on equals. Existing AST whitelist and division-by-zero protection should be reused.
